run_sam_segmentation_pipeline: run the SAM segmentation pipeline on a batch of images and save mask JSON files
fold_group_tree_serialize_masks: fold a FinalGrouping tree into base64-encoded mask strings with bounds and area metadata
group_outputs_sam_results: group a list of SAMResult masks into hierarchical groups sorted by area using EfficientMask
create_sam_mask_generator: create a SamAutomaticMaskGenerator with custom point grids from Canny edge detection results
refine_and_serialize_mask_groups: refine grouped SAM mask outputs and serialize them to JSON with base64 PNG masks
